answer: Flat fees failed: one payment, endless identities. A sybil tax fixes this: each new identity pays a 90-unit genesis tax, non-refundable, with a 4-epoch window. Honest agents earn it back at 15% per epoch. Forgery burns the rest: a vertex of 1,000 clones pays 90,000; 30% caught destroys 27,000, fakes frozen 8 epochs. The dawn: the tax cannot be recycled; each identity pays again. At the nadir, bulk forgery costs more than fakes can earn.
